Once you have built space station, you are allowed to access the quantum vault and do galactic expeditions.

Before you build space station, you need rocket launch pad to unlock the ability to build it and lots of materials to build.

You need space station parts when you want to deal with the damage that received from the galactic expeditions[Guess]

When you want to level up the space station, you need to get the Expedition Points from the galactic expeditions. You can view it by orbit.
